english.title: Tipping off - disclose investigation into allegation of offence committed being considered - Proceeds of Crime Act 2002
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made a disclosure that an investigation into allegations that an offence under Part 7 of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 had been committed, was being contemplated or was being carried out, knowing or suspecting the disclosure was likely to prejudice that investigation and the information on which the disclosure was based came to you in the course of a business in the regulated sector
english.legislation: Contrary to section 333A(3) and (4) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 332(6) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 for circumstances in which a person does not commit this offence.
(ii) See section 332(5) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 for an explanation of the term "required disclosure".
(iii) See section 333E of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 for further interpretation of section 333A
(iv) MoPI group cannot be established from the offence code alone. Group 2 or 3 may apply depending on the nature of the related crimes. Manual MoPI review is required.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
